threshold_review: Keep 10% relative J advantage: at selected control development J=0.004616 this is approximately 0.000462 NMSE, far above the 1e-6 numerical floor. Two development roots cannot establish power; ten independent confirmation roots and the fixed 0.40 CI-width limit decide precision. Keep absolute 0.005 recall/free8/grounded and 0.01 free32 tolerances as declared engineering non-regression limits, not estimated noise or equivalence margins. Report every endpoint even when a tolerance permits a tradeoff. Late slopes for G32/FU38/R52/R55 are 2.17%,5.81%,5.59%,13.78%, below 20%; this establishes the finite screen, not global optimizer convergence.
